# Nunito (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

The overlay's font (`runtime/src/overlay/overlay_ui.cpp` embeds these two files). Source: Google Fonts,
`ofl/nunito/Nunito[wght].ttf` from github.com/google/fonts. The static weights were made from that variable font with
fontTools (`varLib.instancer` at wght 600 and 800), then subset to Latin-1 and the punctuation the menu languages use
(U+2013-2014, U+2018-201E, U+2022, U+2026, U+2190-2193); the font names are unchanged. License: `OFL.txt`.
